coverage: remove then discard closes the draft without changing published rows or history stacks
undo after a discarded removal restores the removed row, renumbers projected rows and clears the stale selected index
removal undo publishes observable Rows/StatusText changes and exposes dirty plus redo state
redo after that undo re-applies the row deletion with canonical renumbering
no production source, IPC, engine, XAML or driver change

limitations: Headless control-plane coverage only; no supervisor UI or wire contract change.
History moves remain refused while a draft is open by contract; the new checks exercise the documented discard-before-history sequence.
No RT-thread, driver, signing or physical-audio implication.
